{{Top|leg}}
'''Take Your Daughter to Work Day''' was a holiday held on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Non-canon history===
Take Your Daughter to Work Day is the topic of a skit in ''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode II]]'', in which a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] named [[Gary (stormtrooper)|Gary]] is forced to bring his daughter, [[Jessica]], with him to the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]] in observance of the holiday.<ref name="RobotChickenII">''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode II]]''</ref>
